title: I could not find what I was looking for - Hierarchical Menu Sort
body:
Hi Algolia, 

I'm looking through the documentation on InstantSearch.js and I couldn't find an example of how to sort an hierarchical menu using a sort function. 

What I want to achieve is sort the hierarchical menu based on the order I have decided on so it's on based on the name of them item or the number of items underneath it.

Can you please provide an example on how to achieve this?

Thanks Algolia!

comments.body: You can provide a function to the [sortBy](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/hierarchicalMenu.html#struct-HierarchicalMenuWidgetOptions-sortBy) parameter. This provided function should be like a [compare function](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/sort#Description). Let us know if that helps you.

Yup! I managed to get it at the end. 
Sorry for the late reply!

Thanks so much!
I have same question, can it sort by choosen velue be first ?

Not sure if this is the best way to do it but you could inspect your DOM and hide the first parent using javascript.

Something like this in jQuery
$(".ais-refinement-list--header").css("display", "none");

Instead of ais-refinement-list--header, you would replace it with the class assigned to the first parent.
I think the choosen one will display none too.
